verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI that scans repos, directories, or stdin, is installable via Homebrew/Docker/Go, and has an official GitHub Action (gitleaks-action) for automated CI scanning on PRs/commits with exit-code-based pass/fail reporting, making it well-suited for headless CI automation. Missing for 10: evidence of non-GitHub CI integrations (GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI) and JSON/SARIF output examples for machine-readable pipeline consumption.
